name: Joash (King of Israel)
title: King of Israel, son of Jehoahaz
summary: Joash was king of Israel and the son of Jehoahaz. He defeated the Arameans three times as the prophet Elisha had foretold, and also defeated Amaziah, king of Judah, in war. His son Jeroboam II succeeded him on the throne.

keyEvents.title: Visiting Elisha on his deathbed
keyEvents.description: Joash wept over the dying Elisha, who gave him a promise of three victories over the Arameans through the sign with the arrows.
